text:
sara: quick proposal — i'd like to try a tiny sidecar running next to the edge proxy to coordinate graceful-stop + streaming resume tokens. goal: reduce midstream 5xxs during deploys and enable cheap resume without heavy state in the gateway.

kai: curious — is this for only resumable streaming, or also for hedging/fallbacks?

sara: primarily resumable streaming and polite draining. hedging still from gateway policy but sidecar can hold short-lived KV for token checkpoints to avoid reruns.

adam: sounds promising. what's the lifecycle? does sidecar own the in-flight tokens or is it a cache?

sara: sidecar is fungible cache + lease manager. gateway asks "give me resume token for session X". sidecar returns token if within lease. if expired, gateway falls back to model-level restart.

mira: any perf impact? extra hop adds latency. how do we keep p99 in check? :thinking: 

sara: intent is co-located process (unix socket) so <200us extra for hit. misses are rare if we keep lease short (~30s) and checkpointing at chunk boundaries.

kai: handshake sketch? do we need idempotency keys propagated from client?

sara: handshake flow (rough):
```
client -> gateway: stream start (client-id, req-id)
gateway -> sidecar: register(req-id, lease=30s) -> sidecar returns lease-token
gateway -> model upstream: forward with trace + lease-token header
if gateway restarts midstream -> gateway asks sidecar for token -> sidecar returns last checkpoint
```

adam: what about security? header propagation could leak tenant ids if misconfigured.

sara: agree. sidecar only stores opaque resume blobs keyed by randomized session ids. gateway maps client->session; we never store tenant identifiers in sidecar. ACLs enforced on unix socket.

mira: failure modes? what if sidecar dies during a drain?

sara: fallback behavior: gateway treats missing sidecar like cache miss and does full restart. we should track metrics: resume_hits, resume_misses, sidecar_errors.

kai: how about memory/billing? we need quota so a noisy tenant can't exhaust sidecars.

sara: plan: per-tenant in-flight cap in gateway that limits registrations, sidecar evicts LRU when over memory with tombstones for a short TTL.

mira: ok. i want an experiment matrix: (A) sidecar unix-socket local only, (B) sidecar over loopback http for shared nodes, (C) no sidecar. measure p99, resume hit rate, 5xx delta during deploy.

adam: +1. also add test for long prompt sequences where checkpoint frequency matters.

sara: noted. i'll prototype unix-socket sidecar with simple lease store. will post RFC PR with design + perf targets.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for edge-canary-3 in 10m :rocket:

mira: nice — if prototype looks good we'll run against canary traffic. @kai @adam please review when PR lands.

kai: will do. thanks! :thumbsup:
